answer: The philosopher most often cited as the “most influential” in Islamic philosophy is **Ibn Sina (Avicenna)**.  According to the standard biographical entry on Wikipedia, he is said to have composed **about 450 works** (books, treatises, catalogued as major and minor) during his lifetime, of which roughly 240 have survived to the present day【1†L453-L456】.  These works span philosophy, medicine, astronomy, logic, and many other disciplines.
